title: SPDL1-IPMS: code and processed data for the human Spindly IP-MS dataset
description: Code, pipeline inputs (Proteome Discoverer Excel exports) and processed tables accompanying the Scientific Data Data Descriptor on post-translational modifications and interactome of human Spindly (SPDL1, UniProt Q96EA4) in prometaphase-arrested HCT116 and hTERT-RPE1 cells. Mass spectrometry data: PRIDE PXD085140.
